name: hud_ui_text_label_on_draw
description: HudUiTextLabel::OnDraw draws the common HUD base, skips empty text, and renders label text with left, centered, or right-style x adjustment while restoring the base position.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4bce30 yet; tier S remains open for a later HudUiTextLabel class/table pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bce30 validates the DrawBase virtual-table slot call, empty-text early return, align mode 0 direct font blit, align mode 1 half-width x adjustment using MeasureTextWidth, nonzero/non-1 align full-width x adjustment, and restoration of base.x after zImage_Font::BlitStringToActiveTarget.

The native HUD smoke verifies the text-label function table maps slot 1 to OnDraw and slot 28 to SetTextFmt, captures the DrawBase slot call, confirms empty text suppresses font blits, and checks left, centered, and right-style draw positions while proving base.x is restored.
